plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Building Inspection Technology A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 25, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7838/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Map states Total Units 64; verified = 15+16+18+15 = 64 (all semester headers match their rows). List A (minimum 18 units; six 3-unit slots: two in Semester 3, four in Semester 4): BIT 102 Plan Reading and Non-Structural Plan Review (advisory ADT 300 & BIT 100), BIT 104 International Building Code - Fire & Life Safety (advisory BIT 100 & CMT 300), BIT 106 Introduction to Special Inspection - Concrete, Masonry, Steel, and Soils, BIT 130 Introduction to Inspection of Wood Frame Construction, BIT 141 Commercial Electrical Code Requirements (advisory BIT 140), BIT 150 California Energy Code - Building Energy Efficiency Standards, BIT 154 California Green Building Standards Code. Map notes this program meets the requirement for the Certificate of Achievement in Building Inspection Technology (minimum 12 units from List A required for the certificate); no separate sequence is published. Advisories (recommended, not required, per map legend): BIT 112 advisory BIT 100 (sequenced in Semester 2, after BIT 112); BIT 120 advisory CMT 300; CMT 310 advisory CMT 300; BIT 121 advisory CMT 300; BIT 140 advisory BIT 100. Local Areas 1A and 2: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
